subject: Shiny App for Live Coding in a Presentation

messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: Shiny App for Live Coding in a Presentation
parts:
Here is a short demo of a Shiny App that allows live coding inside a presentation deck. It contains a two minute video.

http://pagist.github.io/?ba20a329b9f44b9deada

If you are short on time, you can run the app directly using the code below. I would love to get feedback.
require(shiny)
runUrl('https://github.com/ramnathv/InteractiveSlides/archive/master.zip')

parts:
There might be a small bug in the code, since I have seen this error before as well. I believe, it is because I am checking the value of a variable that does not exist. If you encounter this error again, let me know, and I will be on the watchout too.

output[[paste0('result', i)]] <- reactive({

print('running code')
        runCode(input[[paste0('code', i)]])
      }))
  })

Ramnath
